2 × 400 A to the PCS. PCS and rack count, rating and the EMS make to be confirmed by
The EMS dispatches; thresholds (start below 20 %, stop at 80 %, second generator
above 80 % load) are proposed starting values, set with the EMS supplier.
The SCADA never releases or resets the fire suppression; it monitors only. Hardwired
trips act without the controllers or communication.
Update rates are proposals, to be fixed with the EMS point table (open point 1).
Tags as in the I/O list Rev 1 (BESS-, EMS-, FIRE-, ESTOP-BESS, DOOR-BESS).
